verdicts.title: Survey on Cremona groups from a median geometric point of view
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This expository article builds on lecture notes from a minicourse entitled "Cremona groups and CAT(0) cube complexes" and given by the author as part of the 2023 Riverside Workshop on Geometric Group Theory. It presents recent constructions of actions of Cremona groups on median graphs aimed at both geometric group theorists and algebraic geometers.

verdicts.title: Zero Excess and Minimal Length in Finite Coxeter Groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let $\mathcal{W}$ be the set of strongly real elements of $W$, a Coxeter group. Then for $w \in \mathcal{W}$, $e(w)$, the excess of $w$, is defined by $e(w) = \min\{\ell(x) + \ell(y) - \ell(w) \; | \; w=xy, x^2 = y^2 = 1\}$. When $W$ is finite we may also define $E(w)$, the reflection excess of $w$. The main result established here is that if $W$ is finite and $X$ is a $W$-conjugacy class, then there exists $w \in X$ such that $w$ has minimal length in $X$ and $e(w) = 0 = E(w)$.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns excess and minimal length of elements in finite Coxeter groups ('there exists w in X such that w has minimal length in X and e(w) = 0'), which has no interaction with manifold covering spaces or communication complexity of DISJOINTNESS.
